rat.reviewed_by: Codex: direct equal-scale comparison, native Release four views and 24 motion phases, 64px icon, grid and final close-follow world inspection; not user sign-off
rat.notes: 17 functional joints instead of original two palette entries: short segmented legs, weighted trunk, rounded ears, pointed muzzle/jaw and three weighted tail sections. Own grey-brown coat, pale underside and muted pink nose/ears/paws/tail. Original idle/walk/run/punch capability retained with independently authored tracks. Actual exported skinning tested at 64 phases in walk/run: all four paws move, loops join, weights normalize and ground penetration stays below 0.002 world blocks. Gameplay bounds/speeds/habitat unchanged. Production generator reads no reference assets. Close world QA follows the actual body after physics settles; previous clipped close frames were overwritten and not accepted. Performance gates disabled; not a performance pass.
